items.title: App.tsx monolithic coordinator
items.rationale: 1695-line component that owns tab/space state wiring, the shortcut handler map, agent launch flow, AI/editor/explorer/source-control/LSP/updater mounting and the layout. Proposal 5.10:7 and 10.2:1 require rewriting it as a small AppShell + services/hooks (F1:1, F2:2); 9.9:5 requires dropping the root AiComposerProvider (App.tsx:1694). Logic is extracted first (refactor issues), then the shell is rebuilt on the user's design.
items.risks: Highest-risk file: session lifecycle invariants (5.4:1, 3.4:invariant) are enforced implicitly by mount structure; a rewrite can unmount TerminalStack. Needs F1:7 tests before restructuring.

items.title: Tab and app close guards, workspace switcher (logic)
items.rationale: Pure close planning (tabCloseGuards.ts) and the onCloseRequested guard implement TER-011 / 13.2:9 and are UI-independent. Adapt: drop AI chat flush (useAppCloseGuard.ts:2-6,79-97) and editor-dirty checks once editor is optional; move useWorkspaceSwitcher off modules/ai/lib/native (useWorkspaceSwitcher.ts:3) per F2:3/9.9:4.
items.risks: closeAfterFlush semantics exist only for AI history; removing them must keep 'window always closable'.

items.title: Close confirmation dialogs (visual)
items.rationale: Purely presentational alert dialogs ('Quit Terax?' at CloseDialogs.tsx:291). Rebuild on the user's design; behaviour stays in close-guards (TER-011).

items.title: WorkspaceSurface (tab content switcher)
items.rationale: Mounts Editor/AiDiff/GitDiff/GitHistory/Markdown/Preview stacks next to terminals (WorkspaceSurface.tsx:3-6). 10.2:5 and 10.3:4 require terminal as default surface with optional ContentTab/ToolWindow capabilities (F1:6, 6.2:8).

items.title: WorkspaceInputBar (AI composer + block input)
items.rationale: Hosts the built-in AI composer (WorkspaceInputBar.tsx:3-6,24). F2:4 and 5.10:11 remove the integrated AI from the main flow. The block-input toggle event (TOGGLE_BLOCK_INPUT_EVENT, :29) must be re-homed in the terminal area if blocks survive.

items.title: OS/shell info hook
items.rationale: Small IPC wrapper (pty_shell_name, useSystemInfo.ts:16) useful for context indicators (8.5:3).

items.title: OsIcon visual
items.rationale: Purely visual icon; iconography is part of the user's design (UX-006).

items.title: useGitBranch hook
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): Git stays as a secondary tool. (Analyst: Thin wrapper over modules/git (useGitBranch.ts:1). Its fate follows the ide-tools decision on optional Git (F2:6, UX-009).)

items.title: Bundle/startup budget tests
items.rationale: Guards that heavy stacks (AI SDK, CodeMirror, Streamdown) stay lazy and that the bench build never uses the product identifier (dist-budget.test.ts:281-321, 'app.crynta.terax' at :316). Valuable for F2:8 and 13.4:1; must be updated as AI/editor stacks are removed and when the bundle id changes.

items.title: Entry point (main.tsx, index.html)
items.rationale: Boot order is load-bearing: pty_close_all before any tab (main.tsx:30), initLaunchDir before first paint (:33), hidden-window show (:42-50). Keep logic; adapt index.html title 'Terax' (:7, visual rebranding identity:2) and the pre-paint theme key 'terax-ui-theme-shadow' (:11) shared with the theme module.

items.title: macOS app menu with guarded Quit
items.rationale: macOS-only default menu whose Quit is replaced by a guarded item that routes through window close (app_menu.rs:19-53,55-71), feeding TER-011. Menu id 'terax.quit' is internal (rename on touch). 6.2:10 native menu work can extend it later.

items.title: Custom window controls (Windows/Linux)
items.rationale: Visual min/max/close buttons for borderless chrome on non-macOS (USE_CUSTOM_WINDOW_CONTROLS, platform.ts:19). Behaviour is a few getCurrentWindow() calls; rebuild with the new header design (10.2:2).

items.title: shadcn/Radix UI primitives in use
items.rationale: User decision 6 (analysis/decisions.md): shadcn/Radix primitives are kept as the UI base; restyling comes with the redesign. (Analyst: shadcn-generated styled primitives (components.json). Radix behaviour is fine, but the styling is Terax's look; per the UI rule they are not a baseline and are restyled/rebuilt from the user's design system (UX-004, UX-006). Wide fan-in (button: 35 files, dropdown-menu: 11, spinner: 11).)
couplings: every UI module in ai, agents, ide-tools, state-settings, terminal
items.risks: Swapping primitives touches many files; do it per primitive behind the same props API.

items.title: Unused shadcn primitives
items.rationale: User decision 6 (analysis/decisions.md): primitives are kept as the UI base; unused ones may be used by the redesign. (Analyst: No importer anywhere in src (grep 'components/ui/<name>' returns 0): alert, card, empty, item, menubar, radio-group, sheet, skeleton, toggle-group. Dead code.)

items.title: Generic helpers in src/lib
items.rationale: Widely used, UI-agnostic helpers: cn (92 importers), platform flags (21), shellQuote (7, needed for 14.1:2 startup commands), fonts (7, UX-005), launchDir (CLI cwd / open-with), usePresence, useZoom. 'Terax Terminal Symbols' font family (fonts.ts:29-30) is internal; rename on touch.

items.title: useAssetGrant
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): editor/markdown stay as secondary tools. (Analyst: Only used by editor and markdown (asset_grant/asset_revoke IPC, useAssetGrant.ts:21-22). Goes with the ide-tools decision (F2:6).)

items.title: Command palette registry, search and ranking
items.rationale: UI-independent: static createCommandItems (commands.ts:69-306), fuzzy/mode/MRU/quickOpen libs, async query hooks. UX-008/F6:1 want a palette oriented to terminal/project actions: drop editor/preview/git/explorer/AI commands (commands.ts:166-297), make file/content search (fs_search, fs_grep_interactive) optional, add project/profile actions.

items.title: CommandPalette component (visual)
items.rationale: 772-line presentational component (imports explorer FileIcon at CommandPalette.tsx:12, theme picker at :20). Rebuild on design (F6:1).

items.title: Header and inline search
items.rationale: 10.2:2: new title bar. Header embeds tab strip props, agent notification bell, settings/AI buttons (Header.tsx:4-5,27-57); SearchInline routes search to terminal or editor (SearchInline.tsx:4). The search-target routing logic is small and is re-implemented over the terminal search controller (TER-006).

items.title: Shortcut registry, resolver and global listener
items.rationale: UI-independent core: ShortcutId registry (shortcuts.ts:8-49), per-OS defaults (shortcutDefaults.ts:26,94), resolver with user overrides (resolveShortcut.ts:21-37), capture-phase listener reading preferences.shortcuts (useGlobalShortcuts.ts:21). Already user-configurable (TER-008). Adapt: remove ids of removed features (ai.*, editor.*, explorer.*, tab.newEditor/newPreview), add orientation/project shortcuts (F1:5, F6:6).

items.title: Sidebar panel state
items.rationale: Width/collapsed persistence (useSidebarPanel.ts:14-60) matches UX-003, but views are 'explorer' | 'source-control' (types.ts:1). Re-target to a projects sidebar (10.2:6, F1:4).

items.title: SidebarRail (visual)
items.rationale: Visual rail of explorer/source-control buttons; replaced by the projects sidebar design (10.2:6).

items.title: Status bar (visual)
items.rationale: Mixes cwd breadcrumb, WSL env selector, LSP pill and AI controls (StatusBar.tsx:6-12,50-77). Context indicators (8.5:3) are re-designed by the user; AI/LSP parts go away (F2:4).

items.title: Editor diagnostics badge
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): LSP diagnostics stay (secondary tool); the badge is redesigned with the status bar. (Analyst: Shows editor/LSP diagnostics only (DiagnosticsBadge.tsx:1); not part of a terminal-first status bar (16:23).)

items.title: Breadcrumb path utils
items.rationale: Pure path-shaping helpers with tests; reusable for cwd indicators (8.5:3).

items.title: TabBar, NewTabMenu, TabSwitcherHud (visual)
items.rationale: 10.2:3 (orientable navigator), 10.2:4 (NewTabMenu as profile catalog), 10.3:1 TabNavigator contract; TER-003/UX-002. TabBar imports editor language and explorer file icons (TabBar.tsx:17-24); NewTabMenu embeds the agent launcher (NewTabMenu.tsx:13-14).

items.title: useTabs tab/pane model and pure planners
items.rationale: React-state hook (useState+refs, useTabs.ts:586-623) with 8 tab kinds (useTabs.ts:128-136) and pure planners. 5.10:6/F2:1/10.3:2-5 require a NavigationStore with a terminal-tab contract; editor/preview/markdown/ai-diff/git kinds move to optional ContentTab and are removed once consumers migrate.
items.risks: Global window.__teraxNewBlockTab hook (useTabs.ts:804-805). Spaces persistence serializes Tab[]; changing kinds needs a migration (PRJ-014).

items.title: Tab helpers (label, agent status, switcher, cwd)
items.rationale: Small pure helpers usable by any navigator: label derivation, per-tab agent status rollup (TER-012, 9.6:1), MRU switcher, active cwd.

items.title: Window title hook
items.rationale: APP_NAME = 'Terax' (useWindowTitle.ts:6) is user-visible: visual rebranding (identity:2).

items.title: Workspace env store (local/WSL)
items.rationale: Zustand store for local vs WSL distro (env.ts:26-47) with wsl_list_distros/wsl_home IPC; base for PRO-006 / F3:6. Will later be superseded per pane by profiles, but logic is reusable.

items.title: Global CSS, fonts.css and style budget tests
items.rationale: Terax's visual language (terax-* animations, chrome styles). Rebuilt on the user's design (UX-004, UX-006). The budget tests encode performance invariants (no infinite animations, compositing limits) worth porting to the new CSS.
items.risks: fonts.css registers the bundled terminal symbol fonts the renderer relies on (fonts.css:53-66); keep those @font-face rules.

items.title: Code highlight CSS
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): editor/markdown stay as secondary tools. (Analyst: Used by editor/markdown/AI rendering; follows the ide-tools/ai decision (F2:6).)

items.title: Terminal theme tokens
items.rationale: 5.10:9: reuse tokens. Maps CSS vars to the terminal palette (tokens.ts:1-76); UI-independent.

notes: App.tsx is the hub that imports every removable area (ai, editor, explorer, git, source-control, lsp, preview, updater); removal of those areas is blocked by app-shell refactors. Webview localStorage keys (terax.sidebar.*, terax-palette-*, terax-ui-theme-shadow) are isolated from an installed Terax only through the bundle identifier / webview data dir (build-identity); verify in Phase 0. useWorkspaceSwitcher.ts:3 imports native from modules/ai (same issue as spaces/useSpacesBoot, 9.9:4).
